info.name: VibeMail Engine API
info.description:
Generated from CONTRACT.md §4. One folder per endpoint: a happy path first, then one request per error code the contract names for it.

Every JSON error uses the §3.3 envelope `{ error: { code, message, retryable, details? } }`.

Set `jwt` to a Supabase access token for a user with Gmail connected, and `jwtUnconnected` to one for a user without.

Requests whose description starts with "Cannot be triggered by the request alone" need the stated setup.

item.name: 4.1a Start Gmail connect — GET /api/v1/auth/google/start
item.description: Returns a Google consent URL carrying an HMAC-signed, 10-minute `state` (CONTRACT.md §4.1a). Bearer required.

request.description: Open `authorizationUrl` in a browser to consent. Google then redirects to the callback below. The `state` is also saved to `{{oauthState}}`.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: run the server without `JWT_SECRET`, `SUPABASE_URL` or `FRONTEND_URL` set.

item.name: 4.1b OAuth callback — GET /api/v1/auth/google/callback
item.description: Google redirects the browser here. No bearer: the signed `state` identifies the user. Every outcome is a 302 to `{FRONTEND_URL}/settings/gmail?status=…` (CONTRACT.md §4.1b). Redirect-following is disabled on these requests so the `Location` header can be checked.

request.description: Needs a real, unused Google authorization code in `{{oauthCode}}` and the matching `{{oauthState}}` from Start. In practice this step is completed by the browser after consent.

item.name: 4.2 Message list — GET /api/v1/messages
item.description: INBOX messages from the database, newest first, with an opaque cursor. Never calls Gmail (CONTRACT.md §4.2). Bearer required.

request.description: Saves `nextCursor` to `{{cursor}}` and the first message ID to `{{gmailMessageId}}` for later requests.

item.name: GMAIL_NOT_CONNECTED — user has not connected Gmail

request.description: `{{jwtUnconnected}}` is a valid token for a Supabase user who never connected Gmail.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: stop local Supabase (`supabase stop`).

item.name: 4.3 Message send — POST /api/v1/messages/send
item.description: Sends a plain-text message, optionally into a thread, then stores it (CONTRACT.md §4.3). Bearer required. Body: `{ to, subject, body, threadId? }`.

request.description: Sends a real email to `{{recipient}}`.

item.name: Happy path — 201 sent into a thread

request.description: `{{threadId}}` must be a thread in the connected mailbox. It is passed to Gmail unchanged.

item.name: GMAIL_NOT_CONNECTED — user has not connected Gmail

request.description: Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: revoke VibeMail at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions, then send. The stored tokens are cleared, so later requests return GMAIL_NOT_CONNECTED.
Invalid `to`, a subject with a line break, and no `body`. `details.issues` lists all three.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: exceed Gmail sending limits, or point the server at a stub that answers 429. The response carries Retry-After when Google sends one.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: point the server at a stub that answers 5xx. If the send succeeded but fetching it back failed, `details.sentGmailId` is set: do not resend.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: stop local Supabase (`supabase stop`).

item.name: 4.4 Mark as read — POST /api/v1/messages/{id}/read
item.description: Marks one stored message read in Gmail and in the database. Idempotent. No body (CONTRACT.md §4.4). Bearer required.

request.description: Run "Message list → Happy path" first to fill `{{gmailMessageId}}`. Sending twice returns 200 both times.

item.name: GMAIL_NOT_CONNECTED — user has not connected Gmail

request.description: Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: `{{jwtUnconnected}}` must belong to a user whose stored message row still exists but whose Gmail connection was removed or revoked. A user with no stored message gets MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND first.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: revoke VibeMail at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions, then retry.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: point the server at a stub that answers 429.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: point the server at a stub that answers 5xx.
Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: stop local Supabase (`supabase stop`).

item.name: 4.5 Gmail push webhook — POST /webhook/gmail
item.description: Google Pub/Sub push receiver, outside /api/v1. No bearer: authenticated by `?token=` equal to GOOGLE_PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN. Acks with 200 before syncing in the background (CONTRACT.md §4.5).

request.description: Replays a Pub/Sub push for `{{gmailAddress}}`. The pre-request script base64-encodes `{ emailAddress, historyId }` into `message.data`.

item.name: VALIDATION_FAILED — message.data is not base64 JSON

request.description: Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: run the server without GOOGLE_PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN. The webhook fails closed.

item.name: 4.6 Watch-renewal cron — GET /api/cron/renew-watch
item.description: Daily Vercel Cron Job that renews Gmail watches (CONTRACT.md §4.6). Authenticated by `Authorization: Bearer {{cronSecret}}`. Built in BUILD_SEQUENCE.md unit 4.

request.description: Cannot be triggered by the request alone. To reproduce: run the server without CRON_SECRET. The job fails closed.
